name: delivery-policy
title: 交付纪律
description: 演示不改代码就能改质量门：内置一条始终生效的规则，声明每次任务都该有的意图，并在没有验证证据时拒绝放行。
author: 0KAY

always_rules: Before claiming a task is done, run the narrowest command that proves it (a type check, one test file, a build) and quote its output.
Never report a change you did not make, and never report a command you did not run.

intents.description: Verify the change with a command whose output proves it
intents.method: run the narrowest test/build/typecheck and paste the result
